body.x: Samil CDS (President David Yoo, www.samilcds.com) showcased its "Transparent Refrigerator," a beverage cooler with a door installed with a transparent LCD panel, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

While the thickness of the door from other display companies measures at 80mm or thicker, the thickness of this refrigerator’s door measures only at 40mm, proving the level of advancement of Samil CDS's technology in DID technique.

The LED lights adjusts automatically when the refrigerator door opens, adding convenience to the usage. Also, with the Contents Management System (CMS) which transfers data to Android system by built-in wifi, the advertised image of the products displayed in the refrigerator can be collected from the main office, no matter how far the refrigerator is located. The refrigerator can easily be upgraded through USB port.

President David Yoo said, "While there is one multinational company that is already marketing proactively in this field, we are the only one that has the know-how in converging the industrial refrigerator and transparent LCD display in this country. I firmly believe that this year will be the year to see the expansion of this industry, therefore a great chance to show our strengths."

Samil CDS specializes in manufacturing, selling, and exporting display monitors for compound LCD-paneled refrigerators. In this year's CES, the company introduced 24” and 47” Transparent LCD Refrigerators.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
